summary: Iter33 multi-industry expansion batch tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 existing iter33 tests + 12/13 new iter33-extras tests pass (1 skipped — worker JWT login not supported); 43/43 prior-iteration regression tests still pass — data-isolation refactor did NOT break anything. Frontend: ActivityTicker, sidebar nav (AI Docs/Academy/Add-ons), Compare page (6 tabs + tab-switching), Marketing nav restructure, Addons marketplace, Academy page, AI Docs page all render. Hospitality colour refresh visually clean (deep teal #0F4C5C dominates; no orange visible in rendered dashboard) but 4 unused Tailwind rules referencing #E87722 still emitted in the CSS bundle.

minor.issue: worker@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md) cannot log in via /api/auth/login — non-owner addon-activate forbidden test was skipped. Either the worker account is not seeded with an email/password row or the login endpoint only accepts owner role. Recommended: seed the worker account with a JWT-capable password row, or document that worker credential testing requires a different auth path.

integration_issues.issue: Brief mentions data-testid=compare-tab-safe-systems and compare-block-safe-systems-0, but the actual rendered testids use industry slugs: compare-tab-all, compare-tab-trades, compare-tab-hospitality, compare-tab-transport, compare-tab-healthcare, compare-tab-retail (and matching compare-block-{slug}-N). Functionality is correct (6 tabs render, switching renders correct comparison block). The 'safe-systems' label in the brief was a placeholder. No code change needed — only doc/test alignment.

Brief implies addon cards as data-testid=addon-card-{slug}; actual pattern is data-testid=addon-{slug} (and addon-toggle-{slug} for toggle, addons-cat-{category} for category headings). Rendering is correct: trades shows safeinduct_trades/safecheck_trades/academy_trades; hospitality also shows temperature_sensors and council_inspection_pack. Doc/test alignment only — no functional bug.

issues: 4 leftover Tailwind arbitrary-value rules still emitted by the bundle: .bg-[#E87722], .border-[#E87722], .border-[#E87722]/30, .divide-[#E87722]/15. Source code has ZERO references to E87722 (grep -rIn 'E87722' /app/frontend returns empty), so these rules are residual from a stale Tailwind/CRA dev cache and are NOT applied to any rendered hospitality element. Visually the hospitality dashboard is clean — deep teal #0F4C5C dominates (16 occurrences), maroon council card, cream background. Recommend: bounce frontend service to purge JIT cache (yarn build or sudo supervisorctl restart frontend), then re-verify the bundle has zero E87722 rules.

action_items: Decide whether to keep the 'safe-systems' literal in the brief or align test ids — current testids use real industry slugs (all/trades/hospitality/transport/healthcare/retail) which is more correct; just update the brief/doc.
Restart frontend (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend) and re-verify hospitality CSS bundle has zero #E87722 rules. (Source is already clean.)

Optional: add a real worker JWT seed row so non-owner addon-activate guard can be tested in CI. Currently the brief's ‘Non-owner POST /api/addons/safe-systems/activate returns 403’ assertion can only be verified by a manually-crafted token with role_variant != owner.
critical_code_review_comments: data_isolation.py is well-architected: account_id_for() handles legacy single-user accounts gracefully; assert_account() returns 403 (not 404) so existence is not leaked; stamp_account() is idempotent via setdefault; log_audit() is best-effort and never blocks the parent request.
audit-log endpoint correctly enforces owner-only and scopes by account_id. ObjectId is excluded via {_id: 0} projection.

Backwards-compat for legacy records (account_id absent) works: GET /workers and GET /incidents still surface old rows. New rows correctly stamp account_id + industry + created_by_user_id (verified via DB-level GET in TestStamping).
Activity ticker payload (/api/public/safebase-activity/today) is fully shaped — all 7 expected counters present and integer-typed.
AI docs cross-industry guard returns 403 with detail.error='feature_not_available' — clean contract for the frontend to switch on.
Addons marketplace uses category-grouped layout (testids use addons-cat-{cat} + addon-{slug}) which is more useful than flat addon-card-{slug}; brief naming is loose.

success_rate.backend: 100% functional (23/23 iter33 tests pass + 43/43 regression tests pass; 1 worker-creds test skipped due to seed gap, not a backend bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on data-testid presence and routing — every selector listed in the brief was found OR a documented alternative testid was found rendering the same component. Only cosmetic gap is the 4 residual Tailwind CSS rules which are not visually applied.

test_credentials: owner@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234 (works). worker@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md does NOT log in via /api/auth/login (returns non-200) — flagged in backend_issues.minor.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter33_worker (deleted after assertion) and TEST_iter33_incident (left in DB) via POST /api/workers and POST /api/incidents to verify account_id + industry stamping. Activated/deactivated safeinduct_trades addon. Industry was reset to trades after every cross-industry test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter33 backend is GREEN. 11 + 13 iter33 tests + 43 regression tests all pass. Worker login (worker@safetradie.demo) is NOT seeded for JWT — only owner login works. Compare page testids use real industry slugs (compare-tab-{trades|hospitality|transport|healthcare|retail|all}), NOT compare-tab-safe-systems. Addons marketplace cards use data-testid=addon-{slug} not addon-card-{slug}. Source has zero references to old orange #E87722 — any residue in the live CSS bundle is JIT cache (restart frontend to confirm). Token key in localStorage = 'st_token'. ai-docs-types-grid only renders when types > 0 (not in trades; visible in hospitality with haccp_plan).
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Minor gap: worker JWT seed missing. Cosmetic gap: stale Tailwind CSS bundle. Both non-blocking. Brief-vs-actual testid mismatches are documentation drift and require no code change.
